_source.title: 在指定位置插入系统顶部菜单项
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口需要在系统已有的系统一级菜单下新增子菜单，无法新增和修改一级菜单，`id` 数组请至少传递 `2` 个值
_source.remarks.text.1: 本接口将会强制新建的系统顶部菜单的 ID 包含扩展 UUID，例如输入的 `id = 'example'`，将会被自动重写为 `e143d88179874e7f851cc890cd22fc71|example`，后续如需移除该菜单，请输入重写后的名称
_source.remarks.text.2: 本接口不能在 **高级** 菜单下新增任何子菜单
_source.remarks.text.3: 本接口新增的子菜单将默认排列在原菜单的结尾，除非指定了 `props.insertBefore` 参数
_source.remarks.text.4: 注意：本接口需要使用者启用扩展的外部交互权限，如若未启用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.remarks.text.5: 非公开接口使用提醒：本接口按原样提供，不提供参数的额外文档，参数可能在任何版本出现破坏性更改并不另行通知
_source.params.id: 菜单项 ID 树，将会按照数组顺序按层级匹配菜单项，并将数组最后一位作为插入的菜单项的 ID
_source.returns: 顶部菜单项的 ID，分隔线是否插入并不会影响操作结果的返回值，不包含 menuItems 中的子项的 ID

title: Insert a system header menu item at the specified position
remarks.text.0: This API adds a sub-menu under an existing system first-level menu. First-level menus cannot be added or modified. The `id` array should contain at least `2` values
remarks.text.1: This API forces the ID of the newly created system header menu to include the extension UUID. For example, an input `id = 'example'` will be automatically rewritten to `e143d88179874e7f851cc890cd22fc71|example`. To remove this menu later, enter the rewritten name
remarks.text.2: This API cannot add any sub-menu under the **Advanced** menu
remarks.text.3: Sub-menus added by this API are placed at the end of the original menu by default, unless the `props.insertBefore` parameter is specified
remarks.text.4: Note: This API requires the user to enable the extension external interaction permission, if not enabled, it will always `throw Error`
remarks.text.5: Non-public API usage notice: This API is provided as-is without additional documentation for parameters. Parameters may be changed in a breaking manner in any version without notice.
params.id: Menu item ID tree. It will match menu items by hierarchy in array order and use the last element of the array as the ID of the menu item to insert
returns: The ID of the header menu item. Whether a separator is inserted does not affect the return value of the operation. The IDs of sub-items in menuItems are not included
